eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: SIP-8250 (Key Nonces): multi-lane nonce system via nullifier-keyed nonce pairs in VUBS system contract; enables trustless private tx senders
SIP-8272 (Recent Routes): standardized per-block Merkle root buffer system contract in VUBS; enables FOCIL inclusion guarantees for ZK privacy proofs
SIP-7862 (Delayed State Root): header carries pre-state root instead of post-state root; reduces builder/prover hashing load across thousands of candidate blocks
SIP-8146 (BAL Sidecars): BAL gossiped separately from execution payload; allows EL prefetching before transactions arrive, improving scaling
SIP-8298 (SETCODEFROM opcode): copies code hash from existing on-chain contract to current address; reduces duplicate deployment cost vs. CREATE2 or proxies
